title: I am honestly so tired of the anti-AI ludditism in game dev
author: OverRelatives
selftext:
Honestly, seeing people actively try to slow down progress and police how others create games is just exhausting and super cringe.

Nobody is stopping anyone from making games entirely without AI if that's what they prefer. If you want to hand-craft every single asset or write every line of code the old-school way, more power to you—go for it. But the constant hand-wringing, moral superiority, and attempts to gatekeep the industry are getting unbearable.

Tech moves forward whether people like it or not, and frankly, I hope the people spending all their energy crying about AI tools and trying to blacklist developers find themselves completely unemployable in the future when studios have moved past this mindset. Adapt or get left behind.

replies.author: Squishy_Red_Potato
replies.body:
To some people, the way something is made and the effort and skill that goes into it, makes a big difference in how they enjoy it. If I see two seemingly identical pieces of furniture, but one is hand-made by a master craftsman and one is mass produced, I'm going to prefer the hand made one. For a number of reasons.

People take political stances on goods and services all the time too. Look at the BDS boycott of Microsoft over it's active role in the Israel/Gaza conflict. Or when people say "I'm not buying a Tesla because of Elon Musk." The products produced may be fine, but who's behind it matters a lot to some people.

replies.author: Hotwingz66
replies.body:
It is very short sighted to see that anti AI crowd as just "haters".

I use AI but Im still able to see what happened. Big tech has ripped of other people's work. Repackaged it and is selling it as a product. There really is a problem with that. Not to mention the whole 'we are going to eliminate all/most jobs on earth'. Or 'woopsie, our product might cause a cascading event that leads to the destruction of society'.

Have some perspective.

And forgetting about all that, everybody is now forced to use AI. Arms race and all.

comments.author: oOmegaOo
comments.body: Maybe if Ai game devs stopped trying to one shot and letting the Ai develop concept, art style and marketing materials folks would be more accepting like they were with ARC Raiders. It takes years of practice and many go to school for it.
